newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bonds outperformed by rallying N.Z.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bonds outperformed by rallying N.Z.

text.p: New Zealand's bond yield premium over Australia was sharply reduced on Monday after N.Z. debt rallied sharply following this weekend's general election.

Although the election result was inconclusive at this stage, there were no surprises in the outcome and it saw the market there wind back some of its recent falls on its political risk premium, traders said.
"However, it is tough to predict how investors will react to the prospect of several more weeks of uncertainty," economists at Bankers Trust New Zealand said in a report.
The political wrangling between the parties to form a majority coalition could take weeks to produce.

Meanwhile, Australian long-dated bond yield spreads to North American debt markets held steady after a fairly subdued domestic performance with both the U.S. and Canada closed for local holidays today.
However, the local tone was firm after Friday's modest rise in the September U.S. PPI.

The short-end slightly underperformed with domestic bonds having already priced in a 50 basis point easing in domestic interest rates, and is expected to find further price gains a struggle until the rate cut becomes a fact, traders said.
The Canadian market is also expecting the Bank of Canada to ease policy again soon.
